stage3.sig: WEB to DB direct - microsegmentation bypass

summary.thesis_claim: Proposed agent escalates with kill-chain context (higher confidence, correlation markers present); SOAR correctly mitigates on SID match but cannot escalate, correlate across stages, or distinguish cold vs. sequence.

reasoning: 1. Alert SID 9000001 is a P1 microsegmentation bypass detection: TCP SYN from WEB subnet to DB-OLTP port 5432.
2. Policy matrix explicitly DENYs WEB→DB-OLTP; thus any such flow is a policy violation (cross_zone_policy_violation +4).
3. No baseline traffic exists for this src/dst/port pair; baseline match = NONE, adding +4 for explicit breach.
4. Severity scoring: cross_zone_policy_violation (+4) + dst_port_in_critical_db_set (+1) = 5 points → P2, but SID already classifies as P1, so enforce DROP.
5. Graph analytics shows targeted DROP (src+dst+port) cuts zero legitimate flows, preserving critical web-to-appgw path, minimizing blast radius.
6. Prior incidents show consistent enforcement of SID 9000001 with high confidence (0.93) and successful mitigation.
7. Selected containment scope: flow-level DROP 10.1.100.10/32 → 10.1.200.10/32:5432, matching recommended action in threat pattern 'cross_zone_violation_web_to_db'.
8. Confidence calibrated to 0.93 (high signals, unambiguous policy violation, no contradictory evidence).

hypotheses.name: cross_zone_violation_web_to_db
hypotheses.description: cross_zone_violation_web_to_db (probability=0.85) — Direct WEB→DB-OLTP connection violates microsegmentation policy. Evidence: SID 9000001 P1 alert, policy matrix DENY, no baseline traffic, repeated alerts, prior enforcement history. Counter: source reputation clean in last hour, but policy violation outweighs.

hypotheses.name: false_positive_migration
hypotheses.description: false_positive_migration (probability=0.10) — Possible scheduled DB migration script run from WEB host. Evidence: none observed, no admin ports, low likelihood. Counter: no change windows announced, flow not from MGT zone.

hypotheses.name: kill_chain_progression
hypotheses.description: kill_chain_progression (probability=0.05) — Attacker already pivoted, next step likely lateral movement to APP-CORE. Evidence: multiple related SIDs, graph shows path WEB→APP-GW→APP-CORE. Counter: no further alerts yet.
